# SunSpec reference fixtures

`model_1.json`, `model_103.json`, `model_203.json` and `LICENSE` are copied without modification from
[sunspec/models at 90b4a331dcca1d6eac69c1bead952fddcc5852e0](https://github.com/sunspec/models/tree/90b4a331dcca1d6eac69c1bead952fddcc5852e0), retrieved 2026-11-17.
Copyright SunSpec Alliance; Apache-2.0. These definitions are test data, not original MoonPV code.

`tools/simulator.py` derives register offsets from these definitions independently of the MoonBit decoder.
The measurements are synthetic. Model 1 identifies the fixture as `MoonPV fixture / Virtual PV`.
